meta.name: dead-dependencies
meta.description: Find and safely remove unused ("dead") npm dependencies in RedisInsight using a grep + leaf-check + build-gate recipe. Use when cleaning up dependencies, investigating whether a package is still used, removing a suspected leftover, or when the user mentions dead deps, unused dependencies, dependency cleanup, leftover packages, or "is this safe to remove". Complements the weekly vulnerability audit (`scripts/dependency-audit-report.mjs`), which only reports vulnerabilities.
